title: Lane detection scenario
description: A named test case whose test_data entries match the parameters of convert_observations in policy/input_output.py. All observation fields are optional.

name.description: The name for the test case.

description.description: Optional description of the test case.

test_data.description: Ordered observation snapshots for the scenario, one convert_observations argument set each.

cone_colour.description: ConeColour enum name or value (YELLOW=0, BLUE=1).

sensor_name.description: Sensor key used in sensor_age_s / sensor_stamp_ns.

lidar_scan.description: Full raw lidar scan dict passed to convert_observations, or omit / use null when unavailable.

intensities.description: Empty, or one value per range. Null entries are allowed when intensities are absent.

lidar_cartesian.description: Cartesian conversion dict passed to convert_observations, or omit / use null when unavailable. It contains points_xyz, scan_indices and frame_id.

points_xyz.description: Usable (x, y, z) points in metres in policy_frame_id.

scan_indices.description: Original ray index for each point in points_xyz.

fiducial.description: One marker dictionary passed in the fiducials list.

position_xyz.description: Position in policy_frame_id, or null when pose_valid is false.

orientation_xyzw.description: Orientation in policy_frame_id, or null when pose_valid is false.

reprojection_error_px.description: Reprojection error in pixels. NaN means unavailable.

observations_data.description: Arguments for convert_observations. Every property is optional.

cone_data_available.description: True when a fresh cone-detection batch exists. A valid empty frame is True with num_cones == 0.

num_cones.description: Number of cones in the current detection batch.

z_coords.description: Nominal heights of detected points above the ground in metres.

cone_colour.description: Cone colours as ConeColour names or values.

cone_acquisition_to_publish_latency_s.description: Acquisition-to-publication latency in seconds, or null when no fresh cone batch is available.

fiducials_available.description: True when a fresh fiducial batch exists. A valid empty batch is True with an empty fiducials list.

fiducial_dictionary_name.description: ArUco dictionary name for the batch, or null when unavailable.

fiducial_source_frame_id.description: Camera optical frame for corners, or null when unavailable.

fiducials.description: Marker dictionaries. Each has id, marker_size_m, corners, pose_valid, position_xyz, orientation_xyzw and reprojection_error_px.

wheel_speed_in_meters_per_second.description: Unsigned wheel speed in m/s, or null.

lidar_scan.description: Full raw lidar scan dict, or null when unavailable.

lidar_cartesian.description: Cartesian conversion dict, or null when unavailable.

heading_angle_in_radians.description: Heading relative to policy entry, wrapped to [-pi, pi], or null.

angular_velocity_rad_per_sec.description: Body rotation rates about (x, y, z) in rad/s, or null.

specific_force_m_per_sec_squared.description: Body specific force along (x, y, z) in m/s^2 including gravity, or null.

sensor_age_s.description: Age in seconds of each sensor's last accepted sample, or null if none exists.

sensor_stamp_ns.description: ROS stamp in nanoseconds of each sensor's last accepted sample, or null.

dt.description: Actual monotonic seconds since the previous policy step; 0.0 on the first step.

policy_elapsed_s.description: Seconds since entering the publishing-policy state.

is_first_policy_step.description: True on the first step after entering the publishing-policy state.
